description: Implement the Prefect 3.9.2 integration binding mapping GPWCF domain contracts to native Prefect Flows/Deployments/Subflows/Tasks. Pipeline Root -> Native Flow, Stage -> Stage Parent Flow, Step -> Step Subflow, SPU -> Native Task. Preserve domain ownership/identities/results/operational evidence. Prefect is opt-in dependency never a Core dependency. Domain/Native identity correlation kept separate; Prefect State is operational evidence not domain result.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage execution realized as Stage Flow/Deployment via run_deployment(as_subflow=True)
Step execution realized as Step Subflow via invoke_step dispatch Task
SPU execution realized as Prefect Task inside Step Subflow
Domain identities (Pipeline/Stage/Step/SPU/invocation) separate from Prefect operational identities
Prefect State never substitutes for domain result
Typed domain results (SPUExecutionResult, StepExecutionResult, StageResult) preserved through Prefect
Core remains usable with Prefect absent; no Prefect types leak into Core API
PHASE-01/02 qualification limits respected (production binding unqualified)
definitionOfDone: Integration binding tests for Flow/Subflow/Task mapping
Result preservation tests through Prefect execution
Architecture test: Core does not import Prefect
testStrategy: Integration tests for Prefect mapping; identity correlation tests; result preservation tests; architecture boundary tests
